_comment: Single source of truth for who sells on AstroPrecise. Every company field stays null until the owner confirms the Ltd's verified Companies House details and says yes (docs/SELLER-DETAILS.md). The seller blocks on contact.html, terms.html and digital-product-terms.html are static HTML; test-seller-details.mjs fails if they disagree with this file. Do not invent a name, number or address here.
unsetNote: Seller details will be published here before anything is offered for sale. Nothing is on sale at the moment.
